context.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency, GDPR/HIPAA compliance, and robust performance for unstable connections.

## Key Elements
- **Patients & Clinicians:** End-users accessing the platform via cross-platform web and mobile clients.
- **Cross-Border Telehealth Platform:** Core system instances deployed in GCP `europe-west3` (EU) and `us-central1` (US).
- **External Pharmacies:** Regional facilities receiving prescriptions via local EU standards and US HL7 FHIR.
- **Identity Providers (IdP):** Regional OAuth2/OIDC services for user authentication.
- **National Health/Insurance Systems:** External platforms for coverage validation and billing.
- **Regulatory Authorities:** EU/US auditors accessing immutable logs for EU MDR and HIPAA compliance.

## Relationships
- **Clients to Platform:** HTTPS and WebRTC (with audio-only fallback below 300 kbit/s) routed via Geo-DNS/Anycast.
- **Platform to Pharmacies & Health Systems:** Secure REST APIs over HTTPS using mutual TLS (mTLS) and asynchronous GCP Pub/Sub message queues.
- **Platform to IdP:** OAuth2/OIDC token exchange over HTTPS.
- **Auditors to Platform:** Zero-Trust Network Access (ZTNA) via secure auditor portals.

## Technology Stack
- **Cloud Provider:** Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for multi-region separation (`europe-west3` and `us-central1`).
- **Communication Protocols:** WebRTC for real-time video consultations; HTTPS/mTLS for secure API integrations.
- **Data & Messaging:** GCP Pub/Sub for asynchronous downstream integration resilience; decentralized Cloud Logging for regional audit trails.
- **Interoperability Standards:** HL7 FHIR for US systems and national e-prescription formats for EU countries.

## Rationale
This architecture ensures strict legal compliance by isolating health data within designated regional GCP boundaries while supporting secure, consent-based cross-border access. Resilient edge routing, asynchronous messaging, and WebRTC bandwidth fallbacks guarantee high availability for rural users with unstable internet connections.

containers.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency while ensuring high availability and regulatory compliance.

## Key Elements
* Patients & Clinicians (External Clients)
* External Pharmacies, Identity Providers, and National Health Systems
* API Gateway / BFF (Envoy / Cloud Endpoints)
* Video Consultation Service (MediaSoup WebRTC SFU)
* AI Symptom Checker Service (Python/FastAPI)
* Integration & Interoperability Service
* Consent & Identity Service (Keycloak)
* Regional Relational Database (Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)
* Regional Data Warehouse / ETL (BigQuery)

## Relationships
* Patients & Clinicians to API Gateway via HTTPS / WebSockets / WebRTC (UDP/TCP)
* API Gateway to Internal Containers via gRPC / REST
* Integration & Interoperability Service to External Pharmacies via regional standards and HL7 FHIR (REST)
* AI Symptom Checker to Immutable Regional Storage via TLS

## Technology Stack
* GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`): Enforces regional data residency constraints (R-05)
* MediaSoup (WebRTC SFU): Delivers adaptive bitrate video consultations for unstable connections <300 kbit/s (R-06)
* Python / FastAPI: Powers the AI symptom checker with model version logging (R-07)
* Google Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL): Manages transactional healthcare records and granular consents (R-04)
* BigQuery: Processes anonymized regional analytics via ETL without violating privacy laws

## Rationale
Mirrored regional clusters in GCP completely isolate EU and US data to satisfy strict GDPR and HIPAA mandates. Decoupled microservices with adaptive WebRTC streaming and robust regional interoperability ensure reliable cross-border care under varying network conditions.

API Gateway / BFF.analysis:
## Overview
[The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It ensures strict cross-border data residency compliance, regulatory traceability, and resilient performance for rural users.]

## Key Elements
• Patients & Clinicians (Users)
• Regional Edge Router & Policy Enforcer (Envoy with Wasm filters)
• BFF Orchestration Layer (Node.js)
• Video Consultation Service (MediaSoup WebRTC SFU)
• AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI)
• Consent & Identity Service (Keycloak)
• Integration & Interoperability Service (REST, HL7 FHIR)

## Relationships
• Patients & Clinicians -> Regional Edge Router & Policy Enforcer: Sends client requests [HTTPS / WebSockets / WebRTC (UDP/TCP)]
• Regional Edge Router & Policy Enforcer -> BFF Orchestration Layer: Forwards authorized geo-compliant traffic [HTTP/2]
• BFF Orchestration Layer -> Video Consultation Service: Forwards video traffic [gRPC]
• BFF Orchestration Layer -> AI Symptom Checker Service: Forwards symptom analysis requests [gRPC]
• BFF Orchestration Layer -> Consent & Identity Service: Validates user sessions and access tokens [gRPC]
• BFF Orchestration Layer -> Integration & Interoperability Service: Routes interoperability requests [gRPC]

## Technology Stack
• GCP (europe-west3, us-central1): Targets regional data residency constraints for EU and US compliance.
• Envoy with Wasm filters: Provides native edge routing, TLS termination, and low-latency policy enforcement without extra network hops.
• Node.js: Powers the BFF Orchestration Layer for dynamic response aggregation and payload shaping.
• OpenTelemetry & Prometheus: Enables distributed tracing and observability for audit logging and latency tracking.

## Rationale
[Consolidating security filters directly into Envoy eliminates internal latency to support rural connections below 300 kbit/s. Multi-region GCP deployment with Anycast routing guarantees strict data residency and high availability across the EU and US.]

Video Consultation Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It ensures strict data residency, regulatory compliance (GDPR/HIPAA), and adaptive media streaming for low-bandwidth rural connections.

## Key Elements
* Patients and Clinicians (Users)
* API Gateway / BFF (Envoy / Cloud Endpoints)
* Video Consultation Service container, comprising:
  * Signaling Component (Node.js / WebSockets)
  * SFU Media Router (MediaSoup / C++ / Node.js)
  * Session Management Controller (Node.js / Express)
  * Audit & Metadata Logger Component (Node.js)
* AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI)
* Integration & Interoperability Service (REST, HL7 FHIR)
* Consent & Identity Service (Keycloak)
* Regional Relational Database (Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)
* Regional Data Warehouse / ETL (BigQuery)
* Google Cloud Storage (Regional Object Storage)

## Relationships
* API Gateway / BFF -> Video Consultation Service: Forwards video consultation traffic [gRPC / REST]
* Signaling Component <> SFU Media Router: Manages RTP/RTCP media routing [Internal UDP/TCP]
* Session Management Controller -> Audit & Metadata Logger Component: Emits session lifecycle events [Internal gRPC]
* Audit & Metadata Logger Component -> Regional Relational Database: Persists compliance audit logs [TLS / SQL]
* SFU Media Router -> Regional Google Cloud Storage: Streams raw media recordings [TLS / HTTPS]
* Video Consultation Service -> Regional Relational Database: Persists consultation metadata [TLS / SQL]

## Technology Stack
* Google Cloud Platform (europe-west3, us-central1): Ensures isolated regional infrastructure for data residency compliance.
* MediaSoup WebRTC SFU (C++ / Node.js): Delivers adaptive bitrate video routing for unstable connections below 300 kbit/s.
* Node.js / Express / WebSockets: Powers signaling and session management controllers.
* Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: Stores regional transactional data and compliance audit logs.
* Google Cloud Storage: Secures partitioned regional storage for media recordings.
* Prometheus / Fluentbit: Handles region-isolated telemetry and WebRTC performance monitoring.

## Rationale
This architecture enforces strict regional data isolation between the EU and US to satisfy GDPR and HIPAA mandates. Decomposing the video consultation container ensures low-latency adaptive streaming for rural users while maintaining robust audit trails and regulatory compliance.

## Overview
A cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It guarantees regional data residency, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and EU MDR traceability.

## Key Elements
- Patients and Licensed Clinicians (Users)
- API Gateway / BFF (Envoy / Cloud Endpoints)
- AI Symptom Checker Service Container (Python / FastAPI)
- Triage Orchestrator (Internal Component)
- Inference Adapter (Python / LangChain / PyTorch)
- Audit & Traceability Logger (Python Component)
- Compliance Exporter (Python Background Worker)
- Regional Relational Database (Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Autopilot Clusters (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`)

## Relationships
- API Gateway / BFF -> Triage Orchestrator: Forwards symptom analysis requests [gRPC / REST]
- Triage Orchestrator -> Inference Adapter: Requests urgency calculation [In-process async / gRPC]
- Triage Orchestrator -> Audit & Traceability Logger: Dispatches payload snapshots [Cloud Pub/Sub Lite]
- Audit & Traceability Logger -> Regional Relational Database: Writes immutable records [SQL / TLS]
- Compliance Exporter -> Regional Relational Database: Aggregates logs for compliance reports [SQL / TLS]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider for regional isolation in `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.
- Python / FastAPI / LangChain / PyTorch: Powers the stateless AI symptom checker and inference runtime.
- Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: Stores regional transactional data and immutable audit logs with WORM policies.
- Istio Service Mesh & OpenTelemetry: Handles circuit breaking, service communication, latency tracking, and monitoring.

## Rationale
Stateless microservices deployed across isolated GCP regions enforce strict EU and US data residency and privacy mandates. Asynchronous logging and dedicated compliance exporters guarantee EU MDR traceability without sacrificing runtime performance for rural users.

Integration & Interoperability Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency, GDPR/HIPAA compliance, and interoperability with regional healthcare standards.

## Key Elements
- Patients and Licensed Clinicians (Users)
- External Pharmacies, National Health/Insurance Systems, Identity Providers (External Systems)
- API Gateway / BFF (Envoy / Cloud Endpoints)
- Integration & Interoperability Service (Apache Camel / Spring Integration container)
- API Router & Transformer Component
- US FHIR Connector Component & EU National Standard Connector Component
- Audit & Logging Interceptor & Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Handler
- Regional Relational Database (Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL) & Regional Data Warehouse (BigQuery)

## Relationships
- API Gateway / BFF -> Integration & Interoperability Service: Routes integration requests via [gRPC / REST]
- API Router & Transformer -> US / EU Connectors: Delegates payloads via [Direct Java Method Calls]
- US FHIR Connector -> External Pharmacies: Transmits prescriptions using [REST / TLS]
- EU National Standard Connector -> National Health Systems: Transmits prescriptions using [REST/SOAP / TLS]
- Connectors -> DLQ Handler: Captures failed delivery messages via [GCP Pub/Sub]
- Audit & Logging Interceptor -> BigQuery: Streams scrubbed compliance logs via [gRPC / TLS]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Target cloud provider utilizing `europe-west3` and `us-central1` regions for strict data residency.
- Apache Camel / Spring Integration: Powers message routing and format translation in the interoperability service.
- Java / Spring Boot: Implements dedicated US and EU regional connector components.
- GCP Pub/Sub: Manages dead-letter queues and asynchronous message retries for failed delivery requests.
- OpenTelemetry & BigQuery: Provides secure telemetry, PAI/PHI log scrubbing, and regional audit logging.

## Rationale
The modular decomposition of the Integration & Interoperability Service isolates frequent, independent updates to EU national e-prescription standards from US operations, minimizing blast radius. GCP regional deployments and Pub/Sub dead-letter queues ensure strict GDPR/HIPAA data residency compliance and robust handling of unstable network conditions.

Consent & Identity Service.analysis:
## Overview
This system is a cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. Its core purpose is delivering secure, compliant telemedicine while strictly enforcing regional data residency and granular patient consent.

## Key Elements
- Patients and Clinicians (Users)
- External Pharmacies, Identity Providers (IdP), National Health/Insurance Systems, Regulatory Authorities (External Systems)
- API Gateway / BFF (Envoy / Cloud Endpoints)
- Auth Component (Keycloak)
- Consent Enforcement Component (Java / Spring Boot)
- Audit & Transparency Component (Java / Spring Boot)
- Video Consultation Service (MediaSoup WebRTC SFU)
- AI Symptom Checker Service (Python / FastAPI)
- Integration & Interoperability Service (REST, HL7 FHIR)
- Regional Relational Database (Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)
- Regional Data Warehouse / ETL (BigQuery)

## Relationships
- API Gateway -> Auth Component: Validates user identity and OIDC tokens [gRPC / REST]
- API Gateway -> Consent Enforcement Component: Evaluates real-time purpose-based access policies [gRPC]
- Consent Enforcement Component -> Regional Relational Database: Persists purpose-based consent ledgers [JDBC / TLS]
- Consent Enforcement Component -> Audit & Transparency Component: Emits asynchronous access events [Google Cloud Pub/Sub]
- Audit & Transparency Component -> Regional Data Warehouse: Persists long-term compliance audit trails [BigQuery / TLS]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (europe-west3, us-central1): Target cloud provider for region-locked deployments ensuring data residency.
- Keycloak: Handles OIDC/OAuth2 authentication and user federation.
- Java / Spring Boot: Powers custom microservices for consent enforcement and audit management.
- Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: Provides regional relational storage without cross-region replication.
- BigQuery: Stores long-term compliance audit and analytics data.
- Google Cloud Pub/Sub: Decouples synchronous consent checks from asynchronous audit logging.

## Rationale
This architecture enforces strict GDPR and HIPAA compliance by isolating EU and US health data within region-locked GCP deployments. Decoupling real-time consent checks from asynchronous auditing guarantees sub-50ms policy evaluation latencies for reliable telehealth sessions.

Regional Relational Database.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients on GCP. It strictly enforces regional data residency and compliance using isolated regional databases.

## Key Elements
- Regional Relational Database (Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL)
- Regional Relational Database Read Replica
- Connection Pooling (PgBouncer)
- Key Management Service (Cloud KMS)
- Monitoring & Operations Suite (Cloud Operations Suite)

## Relationships
- Regional Relational Database -> Cloud KMS: Encrypts data at rest using region-specific keys [gRPC / Cloud IAM]
- API Gateway / BFF -> Regional Relational Database: Queries transactional and consent data via connection pool [TLS]
- Regional Relational Database -> Regional Relational Database Read Replica: Replicates data asynchronously for read-scale [Internal PostgreSQL Replication]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud SQL PostgreSQL: Selected for robust transactional integrity and regional isolation
- Cloud KMS: Implements Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) for regional cryptographic control
- PgBouncer: Manages connection spikes and prevents thread exhaustion
- pgAudit: Generates immutable access and transaction logs for compliance

## Rationale
This architecture ensures strict GDPR and HIPAA compliance by isolating EU and US data regionally. It delivers high availability and low latency required for rural and cross-border telemedicine workflows.

Regional Data Warehouse / ETL.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. The system ensures strict regional data residency, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and traceable AI outputs across Google Cloud regions.

## Key Elements
- **Users**: Clinical Operations Managers, Compliance Officers, Clinical Researchers, Patients, Clinicians
- **External Systems**: External Pharmacies, Identity Providers (Keycloak), National Health Systems, Regulatory Authorities
- **Containers**: API Gateway/BFF (Envoy/Cloud Endpoints), Video Consultation Service (MediaSoup WebRTC SFU), AI Symptom Checker (Python/FastAPI), Integration Service (REST, HL7 FHIR), Regional Relational Database (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL), Regional Data Warehouse / ETL (BigQuery)
- **Components**: Ingestion & Anonymization Worker (Cloud Dataflow), Regional Analytics Storage (BigQuery), Audit & Compliance Logger (Cloud Logging/Pub/Sub), Data Governance & RBAC Manager (GCP IAM)

## Relationships
- Regional Relational Database -> Ingestion & Anonymization Worker: Streams CDC events [gRPC/JSON via Debezium/Pub/Sub]
- Clinical Managers & Researchers -> Regional Analytics Storage: Queries regional reports [HTTPS via Looker]
- Data Governance & RBAC Manager -> Regional Analytics Storage: Applies IAM and column-level security [Internal GCP IAM API]

## Technology Stack
- **Cloud Provider**: GCP (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`) for multi-region isolation
- **Data Warehouse**: Google Cloud BigQuery for regional analytics and secure storage
- **ETL Processing**: Google Cloud Dataflow (Python) for PII-stripping and de-identification
- **Infrastructure**: Terraform for multi-project isolation and GitOps compliance

## Rationale
This architecture guarantees strict regional data residency by isolating storage and processing per cloud region. It ensures comprehensive compliance and accountability through automated anonymization, role-based access control, and immutable audit logging.
